new_defects.description: The repository ID bypasses footer masking. A directory named ghp_ followed by 36 token characters puts that token into every result's @meta.repo field, although body masking removes it.
new_defects.fix: Apply maskValue to the assembled footer's repository field, preserving only the explicitly exempt cursor.

new_defects.description: regexp.QuoteMeta does not escape hyphens because they are special only inside character classes. Consequently, data[!a\-z].txt becomes a negated a-z range. datac.txt should be withheld by this rule but is served instead.
new_defects.fix: Use character-class-specific escaping that preserves escaped hyphens as literals, or reject expressions whose semantics cannot be preserved.

new_defects.description: Carry is empty until a line exceeds 64 KiB. A BEGIN marker starting after 65,530 spaces straddles the first buffer boundary: retained text has an incomplete marker, and tail scanning lacks its beginning. Following key-body lines are disclosed.
new_defects.fix: Maintain marker overlap across every chunk, including the initial retained chunk, and use the resulting marker state when the line is cut.

new_defects.description: The bounded output queue still applies blocking backpressure to the reader. With output stalled, enough immediate replies fill all 256 slots and block writeValue, preventing subsequent cancellation handling and EOF shutdown.
new_defects.fix: Make queue saturation terminate or cancel the session without blocking the reader, recording the output-overload error locally.

new_defects.description: The author filter remains an oracle for masked metadata. Git filters raw author text before final output masking, so guesses about a token embedded in an author name change returned commits and counts even though that token is hidden in results.
new_defects.fix: When masking is enabled, apply author filtering in-process to the masked author representation and paginate matched commits, or disable this filter.
